WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS conservation_record_count
  FROM scanconservation AS sc
  INNER JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat
), ranked AS (
  SELECT zoneref, insurstat, conservation_record_count,
         conservation_record_count::numeric / SUM(conservation_record_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_matched_records,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY conservation_record_count::numeric / SUM(conservation_record_count) OVER () DESC NULLS LAST) AS fraction_rank
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT zoneref, insurstat, conservation_record_count, fraction_of_matched_records
FROM ranked
WHERE fraction_rank <= 10
ORDER BY fraction_of_matched_records DESC NULLS LAST;
